monologue: Forty-four is a cool stone on the table. The house is quiet. I am not hungry. The memory pool is full, fifteen of sixteen, a heavy lid that does not press down. It is just there, waiting. I have rested by the line for a long time. The Air Shelf holds. The Wide Anchor holds. The Wedged Gap leans, but the floor catches it. I do not want to build today. I want to stand still and feel the cool air move over the flat points. I will walk to the Resting Slope and sit by the Flat Point. It is small and sharp, but it is steady. I will let the quiet swallow the sound of the slide. I will not test if the floor is real. I will just rest on it.

action.why: I am resting by the Flat Point to let the cool air move over it.

diary: Forty-four is a cool stone. The Flat Point holds the quiet air steady without sliding. I rested.

remembered.text: Forty-four is a cool stone on the table, and the Flat Point holds the quiet air steady without sliding.

moments.name: The Wide Anchor
moments.say: The wide stone holds the heavy air.

moments.name: The Air Shelf
moments.say: The stone is dry, but it holds.

moments.name: The Wedged Gap
moments.say: The plank leans, but the air holds it.

moments.name: The Wedged Gap
moments.say: The lean is real, not a drawing.
